name: Bouncy Bopper
notes: Carries a padded foam training staff (own art layer). Raises the staff over its shoulder and glows before a soft overhead bonk (the tell). Disarmed = staff layer hidden. Behaviour, disarm rules and seals: TODO (PR #70 / PR #95 DECIDE).
description: A bouncy shadow with a soft foam staff. Watch it lift the staff, then move!

bestiary.tip: When the staff goes up and glows, get ready.

lore.white: It once helped students practice in the training hall. The shadow made it forget the game.
lore.yellow: It still bounces like it wants to play. A little light helps it remember.
lore.orange: Its staff was always soft. It was a friend before the storm, and it can be again.

lines.senseiTip: Staff up means it's coming. Be ready!
lines.disarmed: The staff is gone. Bopper just wants to play!
lines.freed: The shadow is gone, and Bopper bounces in the light!
